                     The Transparent Layer Problem

Abstract

   This memo describes an incident in which the network layer of a
   submission pipeline rejected perfectly ordinary data‍formats that
   contained no visible fault. z̴̵̶̷̸ The artist's impression, above.

1. Introduction

   The cause was invisible, and therefore unactionable.
